svg.title: From IAM scenarios to a routed temporal inventory
svg.desc: IAM assumptions enter premise, which creates technosphere and biosphere matrix snapshots. TRAILS interpolates annual matrix slices, distributes temporal exchanges into dated pulses, routes those pulses through a calendar-year process network, solves one inventory matrix G for each year, and left-multiplies every annual G matrix by the same diagonal characterisation matrix Q for the selected LCIA method to obtain annual characterised inventory matrices H.
svg.text: INTERPOLATE AND ROUTE THROUGH CALENDAR YEARS
COMBINE STOPPED + ROUTED DEMAND BY YEAR
Years stack Gy and Hy; not Q
one matrix for every year y
stored as method × activity × flow × year
